artifactScopeSensitivity.scope: The same four cutoff snapshots plus the one additional authored Python file with pre-cutoff timestamp. Strict four-path scores remain primary and subsequent stages originally received only those four files.

provisionalRuns.reason: Stopped isolated host when provisional package was superseded by final candidate.

method: Installed Windows DSH NEXT in an isolated temporary profile, native standard and building-loop presets, one trajectory per mode.
Both lanes have identical benchmark prompt, checkpoint specification, feedback summaries and 125-second observation window per checkpoint.

Independent pytest executes unchanged official test cases. Every candidate subprocess receives only its immutable source and current case runtime inputs in bubblewrap. It cannot see the suite, expected outputs, signing keys, JUnit result or network.

Prior-checkpoint suite reruns before every lane starts editing. Before-edit passing case IDs are pinned; each current snapshot reruns the entire cumulative suite. The current admission cases are disclosed positive behavior examples selected before candidate output.

Standard observes test feedback. Building-loop also has host admission enforced by signatures bound to baseline, current source, goal and suite. Latest observed files feed the next stage in both lanes, regardless of whether that stage was accepted.
Raw suite assets, source files and execution tracebacks remain local. Hidden test IDs are hashed, public positive test IDs are reported.
